item.title: Acme Corp Announces Acquisition of Widget Industries for $2.4 Billion
item.description: SYDNEY, March 28, 2024 — Acme Corp today announced the acquisition of Widget Industries in a deal valued at $2.4 billion.

item.title: GlobalBank Reports Full Year 2023 Results; Declares Special Dividend
item.description: GlobalBank today announced its full-year 2023 financial results and declared a special dividend of $0.50 per share.
